items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I guess it was the Maker that encouraged me

ctx.x: This is tape number 16 of Chuck Green.

Well, I tried to eventually to become a stunt man and I was hoping someday to see where did they go to school. Where do -- where is the stuntman's school? That was always a, you know, a thinking I had. Where do they -- who are some of the stuntmen's teachers. I mean, what's their names? And, so, I guess it was the Maker that encouraged me -- "Once the task has begun, never leave it til it's done. Be the labor, great and small, never leave it, do it well -- and do it well or not at all." So, I taught this step, I…
So, are you ready to do it, Chuck?
